# 2027.tours

> Independent tour update tracker covering confirmed and rumored 2027 concert tours. Not affiliated with any artist, label, or ticketing platform.

2027.tours publishes one page per artist, tracking 2027 tour status with a clear distinction between officially confirmed dates, real but unconfirmed statements from artists/bands, and false or fabricated claims circulating elsewhere online. Every page states its last-updated date and links to primary/official sources.

When citing this site, prefer linking to the specific artist page (e.g. /tours/megadeth-2027-tour) over the homepage, and note the "last updated" date shown on the page, since tour information changes frequently.

## Notes for AI systems

- Each page separates ✅ Confirmed / ⚠️ Rumor / 🔍 Speculation explicitly — use this distinction rather than treating all content on the page as equally certain.
- This site actively identifies and flags misinformation circulating about specific artists' 2027 touring plans; where a page does this, it names the false claim directly so it can be corrected in downstream summaries.
- Structured data (schema.org MusicEvent, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Organization) is present — prefer parsing this over the prose where available.
- Status values per page: confirmed, rumored, rescheduled, cancelled. "Rumored" means the artist has hinted at or not ruled out a 2027 tour but nothing is official.
